name: – Borys Budka – Draft Council decision
title: REPORT on the draft Council decision on the adoption of the Research Programme of the Research Fund for Coal and Steel, on the multiannual technical guidelines for this programme, on the multiannual financial guidelines for managing the assets of the Research Fund for Coal and Steel, and repealing Decisions 2003/77/EC and 2008/376/EC
part_text:
The European Parliament approves a plan to keep funding research for coal and steel regions until the money runs out. The research fund will pay out €120 million a year from 2027 to 2034, and the programme ends around 2038. The money goes to research on cleaner steel, land restoration after mining, and new jobs in regions that depend on these industries. Parliament says support must reach the coal and steel areas themselves, not just big technology centres.

- The yearly research budget rises to €120 million from 2027 to 2034, then the fund closes around 2038.
- It affects researchers, engineers and communities in coal and steel regions across Europe.
- Parliament approves the Council's text; the Council must now finalise the decision.
